description: Builds a TV watching plan for a window of time — either one long programme or 2-3 consecutive programmes with small gaps, ordered as a timeline. Relevance comes before coverage: only programmes scoring at least max(2, 60% of the best score in the window) are used, the same anti-noise filter as tv_concierge applies (reality / talk-show / politics / news, configurable), and uncovered minutes are reported in totals.unfilled_min + unfilled_reason, with totals.unfilled_gaps giving each gap and its actual cause (start of window before the first programme, pause between programmes, end-of-window remainder below the 30-min minimum slot, max_segments reached, or nothing above the relevance floor fitting) instead of being filled; segments running past the window carry overflow_min. Use it when the user wants a schedule for the whole evening or a long window (3+ hours) rather than a single pick: "plan my evening", "ce văd toată seara", "fă-mi un program pentru 20–24". TV only (live Romanian EPG, no streaming titles); for ONE decision that may also be a streaming title, use tv_concierge. Accepts start time, duration budget, mood, and channel preferences. Output: ordered timeline + alternatives dropped + totals.

exclude_categories.description: Anti-noise filter, same as tv_concierge (default: politica, reality, talkshow, stiri). Pass [] to allow them.
